items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbjlZIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c2127817a0ff4825ea599e37757951ea875144f8/cubing%20by%20the%20cues%20(1).png) # **CUBING BY THE CUES 2024** Bienvenidos a Cubing by the Cues 2024 la 5ta competencia oficial en el estado de Querétaro, traida a ustedes por el Qro Rubiks Team. *Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender [el reglamento de la WCA ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/#2a) antes de la competencia.* Welcome to Cubing by the Cues 2024 the 5th official competition in the state of Queretaro, brought to you by Qro Rubiks Team. *This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2t)*

items.name: Cubing Returns Raipur 2024

venue.name: Club Paraiso
venue.address: Maruti Lifestyle, Parmanand Nagar, Kota, Raipur, Chhattisgarh

items.information: **Participants have to bring their own cube for the event.** There will be no On-the-spot (OTS) registration.The fees structure is variable as per information given in the [Registration and Payments Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingReturnsRaipur2024#37762-registrations-payments). Please note once you register on the WCA site for this competition, your name will 1st be in the waiting list and only once your payment is completed will your name appear in the competitors list within 1-2 days. All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except New comers) will be assigned to a particular event that they will have to Judge (or) Scramble for the entire event, all this will be decided by the organising team and will be informed 2 days before the event, organisers will make sure that your volunteering will not affect your main events and overall participation. We will be dividing all the participants into groups and will be giving you a time slot during which one and come and particpate in all events and all this information will be send to you through email once we finish all the registration. Check out all the other Tabs for more detailed information.
